This side now reports the active industr.en: This side now reports the active industrial-land variant, source lineage, build counts, and the selected site attributes without inventing one merged geometry truth.
This side now reports the active industr.zh: 这一侧现已报告当前 industrial-land variant、来源链路、构建计数和所选站点属性，避免制造单一合并几何真相。

This tab is reserved so the right-side d.en: This tab is reserved so the right-side deck keeps one stable structure across families.

Toggle Atlantropa-style scenario regions.en: Toggle Atlantropa-style scenario regions without affecting the base map.

Use short intent lines and quiet caption.en: Use short intent lines and quiet captions so arrows support the frontline instead of overpowering it.

Use the bottom command bar for fast entr.en: Use the bottom command bar for fast entry, or start drawing here for the selected line type.

When off, macro ocean regions stay hidde.en: When off, macro ocean regions stay hidden from inspector selection and map picking.
When off, macro ocean regions stay hidde.zh: 关闭后，宏观海洋区域不会出现在检视器选择和地图拾取中。

When off, scenario special regions are h.en: When off, scenario special regions are hidden and ignore hover, click, and paint.
When off, scenario special regions are h.zh: 关闭后，剧本特殊区域会被隐藏，并忽略悬停、点击和涂色。

When off, shoreline, basin contour, and.en: When off, shoreline, basin contour, and texture overlays are hidden for the active scenario.
When off, shoreline, basin contour, and.zh: 关闭后，当前剧本的海岸线、盆地等高线和纹理覆盖层将被隐藏。

When the selected country comes from HGO.zh: 选中的国家来自 HGO 数据时，先检查 HGO 名称、旗帜选项和意识形态标签，再修改归属。

Use Activate or Scenario Actions for map.en: Use Activate or Scenario Actions for map edits, tune Appearance and Transport for readability, then save a project JSON before export.
Use Activate or Scenario Actions for map.zh: 用“激活”或“场景操作”修改地图，用“外观”和“交通”提高可读性，导出前保存项目 JSON。

Use this section when the scenario uses.en: Use this section when the scenario uses HGO source data, HGO flags, or HGO country-name variants.
Use this section when the scenario uses.zh: 剧本使用 HGO 源数据、HGO 旗帜或 HGO 国家名称变体时，查看本节。

HGO preview helps you inspect the HGO so.en: HGO preview helps you inspect the HGO source layer beside the active scenario map. It is best used before ownership, label, or color decisions.
HGO preview helps you inspect the HGO so.zh: HGO 预览可以把 HGO 来源图层放在当前剧本地图旁边检查，适合在决定归属、标签或颜色前使用。

You need to compare the active map again.en: You need to compare the active map against HGO geography or confirm that the selected feature belongs to the expected source region.
You need to compare the active map again.zh: 需要对照当前地图和 HGO 地理，或确认选中要素属于预期来源区域时使用。

Apply the HGO-backed scenario, open the.en: Apply the HGO-backed scenario, open the preview, select the target country, then read the Inspector before changing anything.
Apply the HGO-backed scenario, open the.zh: 先应用 HGO 支撑的剧本，打开预览，选中目标国家，再阅读检查器内容。

The selected country, owner tag, and vis.en: The selected country, owner tag, and visible boundary should describe the same place before you edit.
The selected country, owner tag, and vis.zh: 编辑前，选中国家、归属标签和可见边界应指向同一个地方。

Review names, flags, and ideology varian.en: Review names, flags, and ideology variants.
Review names, flags, and ideology varian.zh: 检查名称、旗帜和意识形态变体。

The Inspector can show HGO names, flag o.en: The Inspector can show HGO names, flag options, and ideology labels for the selected country. Treat these as identity choices for display and review.
The Inspector can show HGO names, flag o.zh: 检查器可以显示选中国家的 HGO 名称、旗帜选项和意识形态标签。它们是展示和复核用的身份选项。

A country needs a specific HGO display n.en: A country needs a specific HGO display name, flag variant, or ideology label before export.
A country needs a specific HGO display n.zh: 导出前，某个国家需要指定 HGO 显示名称、旗帜变体或意识形态标签时使用。

Select the country, enable the HGO ident.en: Select the country, enable the HGO identity view in Inspector, pick the intended identity option, then review the map label and flag preview.
Select the country, enable the HGO ident.zh: 选中国家，在检查器中启用 HGO 身份视图，选择目标身份选项，然后检查地图标签和旗帜预览。

The visible name, flag option, ideology.en: The visible name, flag option, ideology label, and active owner should match your scenario notes.
The visible name, flag option, ideology.zh: 可见名称、旗帜选项、意识形态标签和当前归属方应与你的剧本备注一致。

Use Appearance for map readability and T.en: Use Appearance for map readability and Transport for routes, ports, airports, and network context.
Use Appearance for map readability and T.zh: 用“外观”提高地图可读性，用“交通”展示道路、港口、机场和网络背景。

Tune the visual language of the main map.en: Tune the visual language of the main map.
Tune the visual language of the main map.zh: 调整主地图的视觉语言。

Appearance covers borders, ocean, rivers.en: Appearance covers borders, ocean, rivers, city points, physical regions, day-night lighting, textures, and presets. These controls change how the same scenario reads on screen and in export.
Appearance covers borders, ocean, rivers.zh: 外观覆盖边界、海洋、河流、城市点、物理区域、昼夜光照、纹理和预设。这些控制会改变同一个剧本在屏幕和导出图中的读法。

The map needs clearer borders, softer te.en: The map needs clearer borders, softer terrain, visible cities, stronger coastlines, or a reusable visual style.
The map needs clearer borders, softer te.zh: 地图需要更清楚的边界、更柔和的地形、可见城市、更强海岸线或可复用视觉风格时使用。

Set base borders and water first, add ph.en: Set base borders and water first, add physical or day-night layers, then adjust labels, textures, and presets.
Set base borders and water first, add ph.zh: 先设置基础边界和水域，再加入物理或昼夜图层，最后调整标签、纹理和预设。

Zoom out and zoom in once; borders, citi.en: Zoom out and zoom in once; borders, cities, water, and terrain should stay readable at both scales.
Zoom out and zoom in once; borders, citi.zh: 缩小和放大各看一次；边界、城市、水域和地形在两个尺度下都应清楚。

Control visible transport context on the.en: Control visible transport context on the main map.
Control visible transport context on the.zh: 控制主地图上的交通背景。

Transport controls the overview layer fo.en: Transport controls the overview layer for airports, ports, rail, and roads. The visual mode changes whether you read distribution, network shape, or coverage.
Transport controls the overview layer fo.zh: 交通控制机场、港口、铁路和道路的概览图层。视觉模式用于切换分布、网络形态和覆盖阅读方式。

You need routes, hubs, ports, airports,.en: You need routes, hubs, ports, airports, or infrastructure density visible beside political ownership.
You need routes, hubs, ports, airports,.zh: 需要在政治归属旁边显示路线、枢纽、港口、机场或基础设施密度时使用。

Turn on Show Transport Overview, choose.zh: 打开“显示交通概览”，选择分布、网络或覆盖，再调整各类交通的可见性、标签和范围。

Open Transport Workbench when you need p.en: Open Transport Workbench when you need pack preview, layer order, diagnostics, data rows, or apply-to-map controls.
Open Transport Workbench when you need p.zh: 需要资源包预览、图层顺序、诊断、数据行或应用到地图控制时，打开交通工作台。

Use these tools for ownership edits, bat.en: Use these tools for ownership edits, batch changes, annotations, and source-aligned visual work.
Use these tools for ownership edits, bat.zh: 这些工具用于归属编辑、批量修改、标注，以及对齐来源资料的视觉工作。

Pick the target and the owner before pai.en: Pick the target and the owner before painting.
Pick the target and the owner before pai.zh: 绘制前先选目标和归属方。

The Inspector tells you what country or.en: The Inspector tells you what country or feature is selected. The Active Owner tells paint and ownership actions which country receives the edit.
The Inspector tells you what country or.zh: 检查器显示当前选中的国家或要素。当前归属方决定绘制和归属操作会写给哪个国家。

You are about to change ownership, contr.en: You are about to change ownership, controller, cores, labels, or any feature-level state.
You are about to change ownership, contr.zh: 准备修改归属、控制方、核心、标签或任意要素级状态时使用。

Select the map feature, read Inspector,.en: Select the map feature, read Inspector, set Active Owner, then use Activate, Fill, Eraser, or Scenario Actions.
Select the map feature, read Inspector,.zh: 选中地图要素，阅读检查器，设置当前归属方，然后使用激活、填充、橡皮擦或场景操作。

The top chips and Inspector should agree.en: The top chips and Inspector should agree on mode, selected target, active owner, and split status.
The top chips and Inspector should agree.zh: 顶部状态片和检查器应在模式、选中目标、当前归属方和拆分状态上保持一致。

Use broad edits and strategic marks deli.en: Use broad edits and strategic marks deliberately.
Use broad edits and strategic marks deli.zh: 谨慎使用大范围编辑和战略标记。

Scenario Actions, Quick Fill, special zo.en: Scenario Actions, Quick Fill, special zones, frontlines, operational graphics, and unit counters help you move from single-country edits to a readable campaign map.
Scenario Actions, Quick Fill, special zo.zh: 场景操作、快速填充、特殊区域、前线、行动图形和单位计数器，可以把单国编辑推进成可读的战役地图。

One click should affect a group, a regio.en: One click should affect a group, a region, a frontline, or a planned operation.
One click should affect a group, a regio.zh: 一次点击需要影响一个组、一个区域、一条前线或一项计划行动时使用。

Make a project save, choose the exact sc.en: Make a project save, choose the exact scope, run the batch action, then inspect several affected countries.
Make a project save, choose the exact sc.zh: 先保存项目，选择准确范围，执行批量操作，然后检查几个受影响国家。

After a broad edit, review View, Split,.en: After a broad edit, review View, Split, labels, frontlines, and export preview before the next broad action.
After a broad edit, review View, Split,.zh: 大范围编辑后，先检查视图、拆分、标签、前线和导出预览，再进行下一次大范围操作。

Select a region to start painting, or us.en: Select a region to start painting, or use Auto-Fill to color all countries
Select a region to start painting, or us.zh: 选择一个区域开始上色，或使用自动填充为所有国家上色
